headline: White House pulls FDA commissioner nominee
pages:
The Trump administration is withdrawing its nominee for FDA commissioner, Heidi Overton, according to a White House official and a source close to her, STAT reported Tuesday night. STAT said the decision followed concerns that she lacked enough Republican support on the Senate health committee, which had been expected to vote on her nomination Wednesday. Late Tuesday, the committee's chairman, Sen. Bill Cassidy, said she had enough support to clear the panel. The rest of the report is behind a paywall. The Food and Drug Administration regulates drugs, vaccines and medical devices, so the lack of a confirmed leader leaves the agency's direction uncertain.
Source: STAT
